features: NOTE :- The 2.4GHz wireless receiver is stored inside the Keyboard. Open the battery/back compartment to remove the receiver before first use.
DUAL-MODE CONNECTIVITY: Easily connect via Bluetooth 5.0 or 2.4GHz wireless. Switch between your laptop, tablet, and smartphone instantly with a single tap for seamless multitasking
ONE-TAP AI SHORTCUT: Access AI tools instantly. Features a dedicated "AI" key for one-click access to ChatGPT, helping you write, code, and brainstorm faster
SILENT SCISSOR KEYS: Built with premium silica gel switches and a scissor-key structure. Enjoy an ultra-quiet, comfortable, and responsive typing experience that won’t disturb others
RECHARGEABLE BATTERY: Ditch external batteries. Features a built-in rechargeable battery and an smart Auto-Sleep mode to maximize power and extend usage time
FULL-SIZE LAYOUT: Includes 103 keys with a dedicated number pad and 12 convenient FN multimedia shortcuts for instant volume, mute, and playback control
